title: Frontend Language
acceptance_criteria: Supported frontend source is fully typed and represented in Canonical IR without silent fact loss.
Invalid UI dataflow/effect/persistence/accessibility contracts produce stable compiler diagnostics.
At least one bounded target generator consumes only Canonical IR while unsupported capabilities fail explicitly.
Public support status remains evidence-based rather than roadmap-derived.
